heroHeadline: Day 789: Federal Forces Repel Cartel Attack in Sinaloa–Durango Sierra, Capture 9, as Nine More Killed Across Culiacán and Mazatlán
heroSubtitle: 789 days of cartel civil war: on September 19, SSPC and Navy personnel patrolling the sierra along Sinaloa's border with Durango repelled an armed attack and captured nine suspected cartel members, including a minor, seizing 17 long guns, a grenade launcher and 40 improvised explosive devices. The same day, a mechanic was shot dead inside his home in Culiacán's Lázaro Cárdenas neighborhood, a man missing since September 10 was found dead near San Román, and an unidentified body was found inside a stolen Range Rover in El Fuerte's Jahuara 2 community. September 18 brought four more homicides across Escuinapa, Culiacán and Mazatlán, while September 17 saw a femicide in Mazatlán's Francisco I. Madero neighborhood, a pursuit-shooting that killed a motorcyclist and a driver in El Toreo, a 19-year-old motorcyclist killed in Díaz Ordaz, a second fatal shooting at the same Villa Unión gas station in nine days, a jeweler kidnapped in Culiacán's Tres Ríos sector, and a second US citizen reported missing in the city within 48 hours. The violence continues despite the September 15 deployment of 3,400 additional federal troops and agents to Sinaloa and Culiacán's first public Grito de Independencia in two years. Days of open civil war: 789+.
